To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
chickens are a suitable model for monitoring the effects of heavy metal exposure.
chickens from mining areas are affected by heavy metals and oxidative stress and that this effect is more pronounced at the site of the highest contamination.

chickens exposed to a gradient heavy metals contaminated soil, show a significant accumulation of metals, oxidative stress, and DNA alterations, which are correlated with the expression of genes involved in apoptosis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the assessment of chicken as a sentinel species for monitoring heavy metal contamination in mining areas and to evaluate its suitability as a model for studying the toxic effects of metals.
the assessment of chicken as a bioindicator of the environmental impact of mining activities.
a better understanding of the mechanisms of heavy metals toxicity and their potential effects on animal health.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the chicken is an appropriate animal model for assessing heavy metals transfer and their related toxicity in mining sites.
the chicken model can be used as a suitable bioindicator for heavy metals pollution in mining sites.
chicken and selected biochemical and molecular markers offer a suitable model in order to assess the impact and the risk of mining activity on human and animal health.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most contaminated sites (site 3) are the most toxic sites and that chickens could be considered as a good biomarker for monitoring heavy metal pollution in mining areas.
chicken and selected biological parameters are a suitable model for the evaluation of heavy metals transfer in food web.
chicken and selected biochemical and transcriptomic biomarkers offer a useful model for biomonitorizing assessment of heavy metals accumulation in mining sites.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the biomarkers we selected are sensitive enough to detect the impact of heavy metals on the chicken.
the chicken is a useful model organism for studying the effects of heavy metal pollution in mining areas.
chickens exposed to heavy metals in contaminated areas are a useful tool to monitor the environmental impact of heavy metal pollution.
